a: Logs, metrics, and traces complement each other for debugging.
Log JSON fields for queryable events, not only free text.
Rate, Errors, Duration for request-driven services.
Utilization, Saturation, Errors for resources like CPU and queues.
Follow a request across services with a shared trace id.
Too many noisy alerts train people to ignore pages.
Alert on error budget burn, not every CPU blip.
High-cardinality labels can overwhelm metrics systems.
Link metric spikes to example traces for faster debugging.
Overview → service → dependency for efficient incident navigation.
